meta.name: ab-test-generator
meta.description: Generate A/B test variants for affiliate content. Triggers on: "create A/B test", "test my headline", "optimize my CTA", "generate variants", "split test ideas", "improve click-through rate", "test my landing page copy", "headline alternatives", "CTA variations", "which version is better", "optimize conversions", "test my email subject line", "compare approaches".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成A/B测试变体以优化营销内容
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速生成多个版本的营销文案进行A/B测试
copy.tagline_en: Generate A/B test variants to optimize affiliate content
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create multiple versions of marketing copy for A/B testing

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你提供的文案（如标题、按钮文字、邮件主题等）生成多个 A/B 测试变体，每个变体附带修改理由和预期效果，并给出测试计划。
howto.when: 当你说出“创建 A/B 测试”、“测试我的标题”、“优化我的 CTA”等触发词，或要求对比不同文案时触发。

say.text: 优化这个 CTA：“Start Free Trial”
say.note: Claude 会生成 3 个变体及测试计划。

say.text: 帮我生成 4 个落地页标题变体，目标是提高注册率。
say.note: Claude 会按照你的要求生成变体，并附带假设。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate A/B test variants for affiliate content such as headlines, CTAs, landing page sections, email subject lines, and social post hooks. Each variant includes a hypothesis explaining why it might outperform the original, along with a test plan.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say phrases like 'create A/B test', 'test my headline', 'optimize my CTA', or ask to compare approaches.

say_en.text: Test this headline: 'HeyGen Review: Is It Worth It in 2026?'
say_en.note: Claude will generate 3 variants with hypotheses.
Claude will generate variants and a test plan.

say_en.text: Generate 4 landing page headline variants to improve signups.
say_en.note: Claude will tailor variants and hypotheses accordingly.
